description: Change which layers are selected in the Timeline: select given layers (by number, as typing it on the keypad), add or remove them, invert the selection, select children of parents, move the selection to the next or previous layer or extend it, select all or none

action.description: set, add, remove (toggle with layers); children (of layers, or of the selection); invert; next, previous, extend_next, extend_previous (from the selection); all; none

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: For set, add, remove and children. Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

name: select_layers
title: Select Layers
